title: Chapter 341 - 341 Teacher And Student Exchange; Welcome!

Chapter 341 - 341 Teacher And Student Exchange; Welcome!

Chapter 341 - 341 Teacher and Student Exchange; Welcome!

341 Teacher and Student Exchange; Welcome!

After a while, Hu Tian said, “Lin Fan is my student. My relationship with him is indeed not bad…”

“How about this? I’ll ask him if he can come to the office.”

“Thank you, Professor Hu.” Professor Zheng was overjoyed.

If it were an ordinary student, Professor Zheng could have just gone over.

However, Lin Fan was clearly not an ordinary student.

Hu Tian reminded her, “It’s just that I don’t know if Lin Fan has studied biomedicine.”

“It’s okay, it’s okay… As long as I can ask him,” Professor Zheng hurriedly said.

…

Lin Fan, Ma Zhong, Song Yi, and Zheng Jinbao had just walked to the teaching building when a clap of thunder suddenly sounded outside.

Then, it began to rain heavily.

“It must be some scumbag swearing again. Hurry up and strike him to death,” Song Yi shouted.

Boom!

Suddenly, another loud thunder resounded through the world. It even caused the window at the side to shake, scaring Song Yi into shrinking his neck.

“It seems like the heavens have found their target.” Zheng Jinbao laughed.

“I’ve always been very loyal!” Song Yi said. However, when he said this, he could not help but raise his head as if he was guarding against lightning.

At this moment, the phone in Lin Fan’s pocket vibrated.

Hu Tian: [Lin Fan, are you free now? Can you come to my office?]

Lin Fan said: [I happen to be downstairs. I’m coming over now.]

Then, Lin Fan said to Song Yi and the rest, “You guys go to the classroom first… Teacher Tiantian is looking for me.”

After saying that, he walked toward the office.

Teacher Tiantian!

Song Yi said, “I finally know why the heavens are thundering.”

After saying that, he raised his head and shouted, “God, remember to aim better next time.”

Boom!

A thunderclap rang out, causing everyone’s eardrums to buzz. Song Yi was so frightened that he almost fell to the ground.

…

After a while, Lin Fan arrived at his office.

When he saw that there was a strange woman inside, he was slightly stunned.

Hu Tian first handed him a cup of coffee and then introduced, “This is Professor Zheng Qian from the Biology Department.”

Professor Zheng quickly bent over and said excitedly, “Lin Fan, hello, hello.”

“Hello, Professor Zheng,” said Lin Fan.

If there were any outsiders here, they would have thought that Lin Fan was the teacher and Zheng Qian was the student.

“Professor Zheng, don’t you have something to ask Lin Fan?”

When Lin Fan heard this, his face turned weird. What could she possibly ask him?

Professor Zheng quickly took out a stack of documents from her bag and said, “Lin Fan, this’s a project that Professor Wu Tian and I have been working on since the year before before… ‘Research on Restoring the Balance of Insulins in Diabetes’…

“However, after two years of research, Professor Wu Tian and I have encountered many problems. Here, here, and here… How should we resolve this?”

Diabetes?

Insulins?

She was asking Lin Fan?

He… He did not understand at all.

Suddenly, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve triggered a mission. Watch a biology experiment and read ‘Introduction to Insulins’, ‘Treatment of Diabetics’, ‘Pharmaceutics and Pharmaceutics’, ‘Pharmaceutics Technology’, and ‘Microbiology and Immunity Technology’. You’ll receive Professor-Level Biology Experience, human islet recovery medicine, its manufacturing principle, and a complete thesis.]

When Lin Fan heard this, a weird look appeared on his face.

He had just encountered a problem with biomedicine, and in the blink of an eye, he had triggered the corresponding mission?

Professor Zheng saw that Lin Fan did not say anything for a long time and was not looking at the information. She thought that Lin Fan had not studied biomedicine and glucose. She could not help but sigh.

Even though she was already mentally prepared for this, after getting this result, she still felt a little depressed.

Was the Biology Department really going to fall?

Professor Zheng opened her mouth and was about to say something…

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “Bring me to the laboratory to see your experiment.”

“Huh?”

Professor Zheng was slightly stunned.

Lin Fan said, “What? Is it inconvenient to watch the experiment? Do you need to keep this experiment a secret?”

After hearing Lin Fan speak again, Professor Zheng was overjoyed. “No, definitely not. Lin Fan, our laboratory is in front. This way, please…”

Lin Fan wanted to see the experiment, which proved that he had studied biomedicine and glucose!

This was good news for the Biology Department, absolutely good news!

In fact… Biomedicine experiments needed to be kept confidential, and they were very strict.

However, they could make an exception for Lin Fan.

They even wanted to invite Lin Fan over to take a look.

Lin Fan did not leave the office immediately. Instead, he said, “Teacher Tiantian, I’ll go to the biology laboratory to take a look.”

Hu Tian nodded and said, “Professor Zheng, remember to tell Professor Wu Tian that diabetes is a problem of the century. It’s not something that can be solved in a short period of time. Tell him not to be too hasty.”

Obviously, she was taking precautions.

This was to prevent everyone from being unhappy if Lin Fan was not able to give any suggestions after watching the experiment.

When Professor Zheng heard this, her smile disappeared.

She also understood this principle, so she promised, “I’ll be sure to relay Professor Wu Tian your message.”

The weather in Jiangbei was like a woman’s temper. It was suddenly stormy and suddenly peaceful.

When Lin Fan and Professor Zheng walked out of the office, the wind and rain had stopped. The sun was bright in the sky.

The two of them crossed the wet field and went straight to Training Building No. 2.

Walking in the spacious corridor, the air was faintly filled with a pungent smell, and there were muffled sounds coming from time to time.

When the door of the laboratory was pushed open, they saw three graduate students wearing medical protective clothing. They were doing experiments with their heads lowered.

They were so careful and focused that they did not even notice Lin Fan and Professor Zheng when they walked in.

At this moment, a middle-aged man wearing gold-rimmed glasses who had been focused on his computer seemed to have heard the sound and looked toward the door.

When he saw Professor Zheng, his expression did not change.

When he caught sight of Lin Fan, his murky eyes lit up.

He put down what he was doing and ran toward Lin Fan. He stretched out his hands and bowed slightly. He said excitedly, “Hello, Lin Fan. Welcome to our biology laboratory!”
